windows.notes: When a video will not open, the app says why: 10-bit or 4:2:2 H.264 and ProRes need converting, HEVC/AV1/VP9 need a Microsoft Store extension.

macos.notes: QuickPrompts start as soon as you allow Accessibility, and your macOS Text Replacements win over a trigger with the same name. Includes 0.0.2.8: QuickPrompts (⌃⌥P picker), the clip bin, picture in picture and split screen, flip, loop, guides, speed per clip and Reverse, and gallery scrubbing.
